note: Rejudged 2026-10-28 after BlastRADIUS: both tagged units changed only by the Exchange(ctx, pkt, Server{...}) signature. Accounting answers are not subject to the presence check (requireMessageAuthenticator is Access-Request only) and buildResponse keeps them header-only. Clause 1: TestRFC2866AccountingRetransmitWithoutDelayTimeKeepsIdentifier red on a changed Identifier for identical contents. Clause 2: TestRFC2866AccountingRetransmitTakesANewIdentifierAndRequestAuthenticator asserts a new Identifier and Request Authenticator when Acct-Delay-Time moves, each authenticator the Section 3 MD5 of its datagram. TestRFC2866AccountingDistinctRequestsDifferIdentifier is mislabeled: it proves RFC2866-4.1-4.
